query: Kemon kichu student grade apeal korar pora? Amra janiy na ki amader course-er grade mistake holo kisu kichu.
reference_answer: A student may apply to the Chair of Department or the Dean for the re-checking of an examination script. Such a request may be made on the grounds of evidence of procedural errors, arbitrariness or prejudice. The student must make any request within Seven (07) calendar days of the publication of the mark. The Chair of Department or the Dean may, after checking with the original grader, arrange for the evaluation of an examination script to be conducted by two members of the faculty not previously involved in the examination and marking process, supported by a member of the Examination Controller’s office. The rechecking process and submission of any revised grade to the Examinations Controller should be completed within 15 calendar days.
source_english_question: Are students allowed to appeal their grades if they believe there has been a mistake?

query: Ami BRAC scholarship e amader international student, cgpa 3.1, kintu ami ekta course fail korlam, apnai scholarship er madhye retake fee cover hobe ki na?
reference_answer: No - tuition fee waivers and scholarships, including the BRAC Scholarship, are not applied to retake or repeat courses; you'd need to pay for the retake yourself. Separately, since you failed a course, you also won't be considered for the tuition fee waiver for the following two semesters even on your other coursework, regardless of your CGPA being above the 3.0 minimum.
source_english_question: I'm an international student on the BRAC Scholarship with a 3.1 CGPA, but I need to retake a course I failed. Will my scholarship cover the retake fee?

query: Amarader kichu detail dekhabe ki BRAC Uni te tuition fee structure ta kemon?
reference_answer: For students enrolled in the Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) program at BRAC University, the tuition fee structure includes a one-time, non-refundable admission fee of BDT 30,800. query: Kemon ase, amar kotha bolben. Ei course e exam miss korle make up exam apply korar procedure ki kivabe hobe?
reference_answer: Students must apply for a makeup exam within 10 days from the day of the exam .To apply for a make-up exam at BRAC University, students should first collect the make-up exam request form from the Registrar’s Office. If the absence was due to illness, they need to have their medical certificate and health card verified at the BRACU Medical Center. Following this, students must obtain approval from the course teacher(s) and the Dean or Chair of their respective Department. After securing these approvals, they should pay the make-up exam fee and collect a clearance from the Accounts Office. Finally, students should submit the completed form and all necessary documents to the Registrar’s Office
source_english_question: Can you tell me what the procedure to apply for a make-up exam if a student misses an exam due to illness is?

query: Ami pharmacy course e amar 5th semister e achi, cgpa 1.7 thekei, ami kemon kharap hobe?
reference_answer: This needs attention. Pharmacy students specifically must raise their CGPA to at least 2.00 by the end of their 4th semester (other programs get until the 6th semester). Since you're already in your 5th semester at 1.7, you've passed that checkpoint below the required threshold, which puts your continued enrollment at risk pending review by the Dean/Head of Department. You should raise this with your department as soon as possible rather than wait for the next semester.
source_english_question: I'm a Pharmacy student in my 5th semester with a CGPA of 1.7 - can I keep going without any issue?
